test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following institutes was chosen by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) in January 2025 to establish South India’s first Infectious Disease Research and Diagnostic Laboratory (IRDL)?

options.text: Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute (BMCRI)
Sri Ramachandra Medical College and Research Institute, Chennai
Kamineni Academy of Medical Sciences And Research Centre, Hyderabad

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute (BMCRI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)** selected the **Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute (BMCRI)** in **January 2025** to establish **South India’s first Infectious Disease Research and Diagnostic Laboratory (IRDL)**.
 
• The **IRDL** aims to enhance the capability of diagnosing and conducting advanced research on **infectious diseases**, which are a major public health concern in India.
 
• **Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute (BMCRI)**, located in **Bangalore, Karnataka**, is known for its excellence in medical education and healthcare services, making it an ideal choice for hosting this advanced facility.
 
• The laboratory will focus on addressing the challenges posed by **emerging infectious diseases** and will help in **strengthening the public health infrastructure** in the region.
 
• This initiative aligns with the **ICMR’s mission** to improve public health research and preparedness for tackling outbreaks and pandemics effectively in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute (BMCRI):**

 
 
• Founded in **1955**, BMCRI is one of the oldest and most reputed medical institutions in **Karnataka**.
 
• It is affiliated with the **Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS)**, Karnataka.
 
• BMCRI operates several associated hospitals, including **Victoria Hospital, Bowring and Lady Curzon Hospital**, and **Vanivilas Women and Children’s Hospital**.
 
• The institute is a hub for **medical research** and training, contributing significantly to healthcare advancements in the region.
 
 
 
• **Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR):**
 
 
• Established in **1911**, ICMR is the apex body in India for the formulation, coordination, and promotion of biomedical research.
 
• It operates under the **Department of Health Research**, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India.
 
• ICMR plays a pivotal role in addressing public health challenges such as **infectious diseases, non-communicable diseases**, and **environmental health**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Infectious Disease Research and Diagnostic Laboratory (IRDL):**
 
 
• IRDLs are crucial for the **early detection, diagnosis**, and management of infectious diseases.
 
• They help in identifying **emerging and re-emerging pathogens**, thereby aiding in outbreak preparedness and response.
 
• Such laboratories also facilitate **collaborative research** and contribute to the development of vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostic tools.
 
 
 
• **Other Selected Institutes for IRDL:**
 
 
• While BMCRI is the first in South India, ICMR has been working to establish similar advanced facilities in other parts of India to strengthen the **national disease surveillance network**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Emerging Infectious Diseases:**

 
 
• India has faced outbreaks of diseases like **Nipah Virus, Zika Virus, COVID-19**, and **H1N1 Influenza**, highlighting the need for enhanced diagnostic and research facilities.
 
• IRDLs are vital for studying **antimicrobial resistance (AMR)**, a growing public health challenge in India and globally.
 
 
 
• **Public Health Infrastructure in India:**
 
 
• ICMR’s efforts to establish IRDLs contribute to building a robust **disease surveillance system** and improving **healthcare delivery**.
 
• This initiative aligns with the Government of India’s vision of achieving **Universal Health Coverage (UHC)** and strengthening public health capacity.
